scientific_integrity: The Dirichlet-multinomial formula and its derived ratio are explicit; analytical proofs establish the global and asymptotic statements. Finite checks are supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Single Dirichlet component; fixed positive concentrations, distinct categories, positive fixed target frequency, at least three categories; no generalization to mixtures or aggregate occupancy counts. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A universal one-crossing law for missing and rare categories in Dirichlet-multinomial sampling
